newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures move up again,marks near high.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures move up again,marks near high.

text.p: April 17 - IMM currency futures drifted upward again, with marks, Swiss francs setting fresh session peaks. Traders said one fund bought 1,000 June Swiss, sold 1,000 marks as a spread, which helped underpin Swiss. June marks returned to resistance at its ovenright peak at $0.5835. Some said it could retest high, pegged better resistance near $0.5851. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
